<p class="hero-main-name">Ran Wang</p>
<p class="hero-name-alt">王冉</p>
<p class="hero-affiliation">School of Geographic Sciences, East China Normal University · M.Sc. in Human Geography, 2026</p>
<p class="hero-interests">High-Skilled Mobility · Scientific Collaboration Networks · Corporate Innovation · Urban & Regional Innovation</p>

My research examines how high-skilled researchers move across cities and institutions, and how scientific collaboration and innovation activity are spatially organised around those movements. I build longitudinal relational datasets from career histories, publications, coauthorship records, institutional and city sources, and firm-level innovation data, and use choice models, network analysis, and spatial methods to study mobility, research ties, and regional innovation.

## Research Interests

::: {.selected-research-grid}
::: {.selected-research-card}
<span>01</span>
<h3>High-Skilled Mobility & Location Choice</h3>
<p class="selected-title">Examines the spatial mobility of highly skilled researchers across institutions and cities, with particular attention to how prior knowledge exposure, career histories, and urban opportunity structures are associated with destination choice and longer-term mobility trajectories.</p>
<p class="evidence-line">Mobility networks · city choice · career histories · spatial opportunity</p>

[View Publications →](publications.html#high-skilled-mobility){.publication-link}
:::

::: {.selected-research-card}
<span>02</span>
<h3>Scientific Collaboration & Relational Dynamics</h3>
<p class="selected-title">Examines the formation, persistence, interruption, and recurrence of scientific collaboration, with particular attention to relational history, current collaboration portfolios, and temporal context.</p>
<p class="evidence-line">Coauthor ties · relational history · dormant spells · recurrence</p>

[View Publications →](publications.html#scientific-collaboration){.publication-link}
:::

::: {.selected-research-card}
<span>03</span>
<h3>Corporate Innovation & Knowledge Assets</h3>
<p class="selected-title">Examines how technological and brand-oriented innovation assets are combined and evolve over time using firm-year data on R&D, patents, trademarks, industries, and national contexts.</p>
<p class="evidence-line">R&D firms · patents · trademarks · firm-year measurement</p>

[View Publications →](publications.html#corporate-innovation){.publication-link}
:::
:::

:::
